name: capcut_add_video_clip
description: Adds a video or image file to a CapCut video track. Media metadata (duration, resolution) is automatically probed.

duration_seconds.description: Clip duration in seconds. Defaults to full media length (or 3s for images).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video or image file on disk.

source_start_seconds.description: Starting in-point within the source file in seconds.

start_time_seconds.description: Start time on timeline in seconds, or 'auto_append' to append sequentially.

track_index.description: Track index (0 = main track, 1+ = overlay / PIP tracks).

x.description: Horizontal position offset normalized [-1.0 to 1.0]. 0.0 is center.

y.description: Vertical position offset normalized [-1.0 to 1.0]. 0.0 is center.
